# MaterialGrowthFabricationFocus

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A strategic emphasis on the materials growth and manufacturing stage, rather than discovery or integration, to bridge AI design and scalable production. Directs TCC efforts toward physical-layer enablers for topological materials, which are essential for robust, low-energy computing substrates.
